# 🗃️ Data Dictionary Template

| Table | Column | Type | Nullable | Meaning | Sensitive? | Retention |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | | | | | | |

## Relationships
Describe foreign keys, cardinality, deletion behavior and indexes.

## Constraints
Document uniqueness, allowed values, check constraints and invariants.

## Access
List roles/services that can read or write each sensitive field.

## Lifecycle
Describe creation, update, archival, deletion and backup handling.

## Review
Owner, date, migration reference and approval.
